test_title: PYST 05: SSC Stenographer - English Language & Comprehension (Held On: 11 Dec 2024 - Shift 2)
subject: english
question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank no. 2.
solution:
The correct answer is '**up**'.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The phrase “lock himself up” means to confine oneself in a place, usually a room, due to distress or isolation.
 
• The word “up” is commonly used with “lock” to indicate complete isolation or seclusion.
 
• "**Up**" fits well as it conveys Shan’s emotional state and his withdrawal from the world.
 
• Other options ("**off**", "**over**", "**out**") do not correctly fit the meaning of shutting oneself inside.

Therefore, the correct answer is '**Option 4**'.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Off: Usually means to leave or depart, which does not fit in this context.
 
• Over: Indicates movement across something, which does not convey the meaning of locking oneself in.
 
• Out: Means leaving a place rather than staying locked inside.
